July 27, 1941.

Discovery of a smoke bomb at a Japanese department
store in French Concession

At 10.30 a.m. July 28, a smoke bomb, wrapped
in newspaper, was found lying on a counter in the
Piece Goods Department of the Gohdo Department Store
(日商合同百貨商店), a Japanese concern, at No. 1
Rue Massenet, corner of Avenue Joffre. The missile
was later removed by French Police. A party of
Japanese gendarmes also attended.
Nothing is known as to how the bomb came to
be left there.

lo 29/7.

Yokoyama
27/7 A.C. (S)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ★ COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE ★ 28 JULY 1941）

1941年7月27日。

法租界一家日本百货店内发现烟雾弹

7月28日上午10时30分，在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）与马思南路（Rue Massenet）转角处马思南路1号的日本商号合同百货商店（Gohdo Department Store，日商合同百貨商店）的布匹部柜台上，发现一枚用报纸包裹的烟雾弹。该投掷物后由法国巡捕移除。一队日本宪兵亦到场。

目前尚不清楚该烟雾弹是如何被遗留在那里的。

lo 29/7.

横山 (Yokoyama)
27/7 A.C. (S)

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 ★ 总监办公室 ★ 1941年7月28日）
